description: Plays one loaded WAV file over and over, with a volume slider and a stereo pair of outputs

params.text: Sets the playback level, from silence to the full level of the file

inputs.text: A rising edge restarts the file from its beginning

outputs.text: The left channel of the file; a mono file is carried on both outputs
The right channel of the file; a mono file is carried on both outputs

notes: the outputs stay silent until a WAV file is loaded: right-click the panel and click the item under the Sample label, which reads [ EMPTY ] until then
the waveform of the loaded file is drawn across the panel, and the file plays over and over on its own with no trigger patched
menu: Output Range — rescales the audio into one of eight voltage ranges, from -10.0 to 10.0 down to 0.0 to 1.0, with -5.0 to 5.0 to start with
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Sample — the item under this label loads the WAV file, and prints the filename it holds

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
